# VST3 interface subset, pinned

Unmodified interface headers and three interface implementation files from
Steinberg VST3 SDK **v3.8.1_build_84**, root commit
`3cdf9ca5d1f5b1b21e0a86832aa4abe55607bd96`:

- `pluginterfaces`: `4f547e8e102b47de4a8b8aaf343c73b700786372`
- `public.sdk`: `586dc5e6c8012c3e4b01c79389375cbe96bdb1da`

[Upstream SDK](https://github.com/steinbergmedia/vst3sdk).
`manifest.json` records source archive URLs/hashes and the size/SHA-256 of every
imported file. Only interface headers, `funknown.cpp`, `coreiids.cpp`,
`vstinitiids.cpp` and their original MIT notices are included. No VSTGUI, samples,
third-party sample libraries or SDK build scripts are bundled. The original
interface notice is also copied unchanged to `LICENSE.txt` at this subset root.
